11 Wealth gotten by vanity shall be diminished: but he that gathereth by labour shall increase. (Proverbs 13:11 KJV)

This verse is telling us the proper way to get wealth. If it is gotten by any vanity, or inherited, or won, or stolen, etc., then it will not last. It is true that most people who win the lottery, or inherit a fortune, soon lose it all, and end up worse than before they got it. It could be that it is not really appreciated when it is not earned, and therefore is not taken care of like it should be. If working gets your wealth, then you tend to look after it a lot better, and not squander it on foolish things. We should always remember that our true wealth lies in the Kingdom of God, where there is no currency needed.

If you are a wise Christian, then no matter where your wealth comes from, you will sow it into the Kingdom of God by planting seeds (Matthew 6:20-21). God tells us in His Word, that if we will sow seeds and be a sower, then He will see to it that we get the seeds to sow. You cannot take your wealth with you when you die, but you can send it on ahead of you by sowing it into the Kingdom of God while you are on earth. Every time you help a needy person, support a missionary, or like thing, then you are sending blessings on ahead of you into the heavenly realm, and you will enjoy them for eternity when you get to heaven. I believe that I would rather be rich in heaven for eternity, than to have money here on earth for a short time. Thank you Lord for being my bank!
